inputs.text: [excited] Mam… muth… us. [curious] That's a very old word that means something like "horn of the earth" — the first hunters who found its tusks frozen in the ground [amazed] thought they were horns.

[happily] A totally furry elephant, yes. [serious] And careful: it didn't live with the dinosaurs. It showed up way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] a hundred thousand years ago, when the Earth was all cold.
[confident] Long after. In Europe, Asia, and [warmly] North America, everywhere it was freezing.
